review.notes: All 57 physical pages were scanned by normalized PDF-text versus OCR containment diffing; every flagged line was resolved against the OCR text (math/LaTeX notation differences) or confirmed as droppage. Pages 16, 19, 22, 41, 49, 50, 51 and 53 were rendered and visually inspected to verify the Table 5 footnote block, page footnotes 1-2, guideline heading styles and the C.3 prompt box. Code-fence markers are absent from the OCR source and the Table 5/Table 10 HTML tables carry all printed values. Figure 3's caption on physical p.13 reads "pseuduo-labeling" where the PDF itself prints the typo "pseduo-labeling"; left unchanged because the misspelling is in the source. Repeated "SAJ CLAP OVR" table-header rows flagged by the diff exist inside the OCR HTML tables. Q12 on physical p.51 was verified as a standalone bold title and its heading was kept.

$^{f}$ Slakh2100 (Manilow et al., 2019).  
$^{g}$ MedleyDB; URMP (Bittner et al., 2014; Li et al., 2018).  
$^{h}$ AudioSep benchmark from mixtures of AudioSet, AudioCaps, Clotho, etc. (Liu et al., 2022; Kim et al., 2019; Drossos et al., 2020; Gemmeke et al., 2017).  
$^{i}$ DCASE language-queried source separation benchmark (e.g., DCASE 2024 Task 8).  
$^{j}$ CLAP-based text-queried separation benchmarks (Ma et al., 2024).  
$^{k}$ AV speech separation on AVSpeech, LRS2/LRS3, VoxCeleb (Ephrat et al., 2018; Afouras et al., 2018; Chung et al., 2018).  
$^{l}$ MUSIC is a canonical AV instrument separation dataset, used by Zhao et al. (2018).  
$^{m}$ AVSBench; LU-AVS (Zhou et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2024a).  
Abbrev.: Real Y/N/M; Sp. clean = speech cleaning; Spkr sep. = speaker separation; General = open-domain / general sound separation; Mus. clean = music cleaning; Instr. stems = instrument stem separation; Prompts: T=text, V=visual, S=temporal spans.
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.16 prints the Table 5 footnote block with entries a-m followed by the two-line Abbrev. note (visually verified at 120 dpi). The OCR kept only footnote bodies a, c, e, g, h and dropped b, d, f, i, j, k, l, m plus the Abbrev. line even though the superscript markers survive inside the table cells (LibriMixb, FUSSd, Slakh2100f, sep.i, sep.j, sep.k, MUSICl, LU-AVSm). The patch restores the missing footnote bodies in the PDF's order; existing lines are kept byte-identical.
